text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined I'd be able to<n>witness such an
incredible<n>performance up close!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm not! You've just gone and<n>inspired hopes and
dreams within<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can gain special skills as long as<n>you work
hard! Nothing's impossible<n>in this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thank you for showing me<n>the path!
